scope: Handoff preflight checks only. Probe body, CMake, models, services, GPUs and network were not invoked.

help.stdout:
usage: reproduce_build_review.py [-h] --repo REPO --cmake CMAKE --output
                                 OUTPUT [--skip-cmake-configure]

Read-only review of the frozen repo; all mutations stay in a
TemporaryDirectory. No model, service, GPU, or network operation is performed.
CMake only configures CPU targets; its small compiler-feature probes may
compile/run trivial programs. The UI script's two network DOWNLOAD calls are
replaced in an isolated copy by a deterministic failure stub. This is a
branch-reachability test, not a download. Requires the frozen commit with no
tracked working-tree changes.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO
  --cmake CMAKE
  --output OUTPUT
  --skip-cmake-configure
